import numpy as np

# NASA outlay data from FY 2008-2017 (in millions of dollars)
# From 2012 bulletin: 2008-2012
# From 2017 bulletin: 2013-2017
nasa_outlays = [
    17834,  # 2008
    19168,  # 2009
    18906,  # 2010
    17617,  # 2011
    17190,  # 2012
    16978,  # 2013
    17093,  # 2014
    18272,  # 2015
    18828,  # 2016
    18698   # 2017
]

# Sort the data
data = np.sort(nasa_outlays)
print("Sorted NASA outlays (millions):", data)

# Calculate 10% Winsorized mean
# For n=10, 10% of 10 = 1 observation on each end
winsorized = np.copy(data)
# Replace lowest value with value at 10th percentile
# Replace highest value with value at 90th percentile
# Position for 10th percentile: 1 + 0.1*(n-1) = 1 + 0.9 = 1.9
# Position for 90th percentile: 1 + 0.9*(n-1) = 1 + 8.1 = 9.1

p10_idx = 1 + 0.1 * (len(data) - 1)  # 1.9
p90_idx = 1 + 0.9 * (len(data) - 1)  # 9.1

p10_value = data[0] + 0.1 * (data[1] - data[0])  # Linear interpolation at 1.9
p90_value = data[8] + 0.1 * (data[9] - data[8])  # Linear interpolation at 9.1

print(f"\n10th percentile value (at index {p10_idx}): {p10_value}")
print(f"90th percentile value (at index {p90_idx}): {p90_value}")

# Winsorize
winsorized[0] = p10_value
winsorized[-1] = p90_value

print(f"\nWinsorized data: {winsorized}")

# Calculate winsorized mean
winsorized_mean = np.mean(winsorized)
print(f"\n10% Winsorized mean: {winsorized_mean} million")
print(f"10% Winsorized mean in billions: {winsorized_mean/1000:.2f}")

# Calculate winsorized range
winsorized_range = winsorized[-1] - winsorized[0]
print(f"\nWinsorized range: {winsorized_range} million")
print(f"Winsorized range in billions: {winsorized_range/1000:.2f}")
EOF
